notes: MOST DRAMATIC: Vault Health Check — CLI: 33s/11K tokens/8 calls → Baseline: 275s/55K tokens/13 calls. 8.3x slower, 4.9x more tokens.
Query Base Data: CLI base:query in 84s/32K tokens vs baseline scanning 57 files in 159s/38K tokens (1.9x slower).
Task Management: with_skill fell back to Glob+Read for listing (obsidian tasks only finds checkbox tasks, not TaskNotes). base:query on task views would fix this.
Summarize Sessions: with_skill used MORE tool calls (37 vs 8) but FEWER tokens (26K vs 42K) — many small CLI calls vs few large Read calls. Net token savings: 38%.
Create Canvas: json-canvas skill added spec-compliant 16-char hex IDs and proper toEnd=arrow. Token usage nearly identical (16K vs 16K).
KEY IMPROVEMENT NEEDED: obsidian-cli is a passive reference doc — needs to become an active redirector that says 'prefer CLI over Read/Edit/Write for vault operations'.
KEY IMPROVEMENT NEEDED: obsidian-project-management should direct to obsidian base:query for task listing instead of relying on Glob+Read.
KEY IMPROVEMENT NEEDED: No skill teaches the minimal-context CLI pattern: outline → properties → targeted read. This would save even more tokens.
